scientific_integrity: The finite-field character sum and alternating-rank spectrum are classical and credited. The proposed additional result is the exact sharp endpoint-norm parity monotonicity, with two distinct limits and direct proofs.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-two fields only; full Veronese cone including the origin; no norm-extremizer classification. Existing association-scheme results cover ingredients of the computation. Historical priority remains bounded; independent validation not carried out.
title: Strict parity monotonicity and two distinct limits for binary Veronese Fourier projection norms
